newsitem.title: USA: Nortech Systems posts Q4 loss after charge.
newsitem.headline: Nortech Systems posts Q4 loss after charge.

text.p: Nortech Systems Inc said Thursday a one-time charge to write off excess inventory and cover costs associated with recent acquisitions caused a loss in the fourth quarter ended December 31.
Nortech reported a loss of $234,375, or $0.10 a share, compared with a profit of $631,286, or $0.25, in 1995. Sales rose to $7.8 million from $4.9 million, Nortech said.
The company said operating income was $395,915, or $0.17 a share, versus $424,899, or $0.17, before the charge of $654,000.
Nortech makes wire harnesses, cable and electronic products for the commercial and defense industries.
Its shares closed down 1/64 Thursday at 4-63/64.
